items.title: Drone strike on sanctioned Russian ship brings war risk to Baltic shipping lanes
items.summary: A drone attack on a sanctioned Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland has heightened concerns for marine war risk underwriters operating in Baltic shipping lanes.

items.title: Brokerslink expands global network with Ardonagh's Orvia and four new retail brokers
items.summary: Global broking network Brokerslink has added five new affiliates, including Ardonagh's pan-European MGA platform Orvia and retail brokers in Mongolia, Madagascar, Nicaragua and Paraguay.

items.title: IPT receipts fall £114 million as seven-month total slips below last year
items.summary: UK Insurance Premium Tax receipts dropped in October, pulling the seven-month total behind the record pace set in the previous year.

items.title: TBIG makes fifth deal of 2026 with century-old Leicester broker
items.summary: The Broker Investment Group has acquired century-old Leicester broker R Jones Insurance Brokers to integrate into its regional hub.
